暑い [あつい] (common)

Writings: 暑い
Readings: あつい・あづい・あぢぃ・あぢー・あぢい・あっつい・アツイ・アツい
Furigana: 暑[あつ]い

Adjective (keiyoushi)

  1. hot; warm; sultry; heated
  2. passionate; impassioned; burning (desire, etc.)
  3. on everybody's mind; on the radar; du jour; interested (gaze, etc.)

Antonyms:
  寒い  [さむい]  cold (e.g. weather)
